latest_release.name: ThingsBoard 4.4.1 Release
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
### Security
* Fixed CVE-2026-18036, CVE-2026-59949, CVE-2026-71888, CVE-2026-71889, CVE-2026-71891, CVE-2026-76183, CVE-2026-90559, CVE-2026-93452, CVE-2026-102554, CVE-2026-106450, CVE-2026-106451, CVE-2026-107314, CVE-2026-108106 by @ViacheslavKlimov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16292
* Protected OAuth2 authorization request cookie from tampering by @ViacheslavKlimov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16363
* Fixed arbitrary file write in TBEL script sandbox by @zzzeebra in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/15930
* Fixed CVE-2026-76844, CVE-2026-93687, CVE-2026-93748, CVE-2026-93749, CVE-2026-101896, CVE-2026-102276, CVE-2026-102278, CVE-2026-102422, CVE-2026-102992, CVE-2026-104850, CVE-2026-110816, CVE-2026-111752, CVE-2026-111755, CVE-2026-111756, CVE-2026-111767, CVE-2026-111768 by @mtsymbarov-del in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16392
* Fixed CVE-2025-13466, CVE-2026-5758, CVE-2026-9358, CVE-2026-12590, CVE-2026-24001, CVE-2026-33532, CVE-2026-41148, CVE-2026-41149, CVE-2026-41150, CVE-2026-41159, CVE-2026-41907, CVE-2026-49458, CVE-2026-49459, CVE-2026-49978, and 34 others by @vvlladd28 in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16405
* Fixed CVE-2026-101296, CVE-2026-101356 by @ViacheslavKlimov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16413
* Fixed CVE-2026-116689 and CVE-2026-118772 by @mtsymbarov-del in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16577
* Fixed CVE-2026-116689 by @mtsymbarov-del in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16575
* Fixed CVE-2026-59171, CVE-2026-106554, CVE-2026-110879 by @ViacheslavKlimov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16740
* Fixed CVE-2026-59171, CVE-2026-106554, CVE-2026-110879 by @ViacheslavKlimov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16742
### Core & Rule Engine
* Added integration-specific encoders for TTN/TTI/MQTT/LORIOT integrations by @ViacheslavKlimov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16300
* Allowed customer users to pick tenant JS modules in widget actions by @zzzeebra in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16303
* Improved startup performance of calculated fields in multi-tenant deployments by @smatvienko-tb in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16329
* Made AI features work on instances behind NAT or a firewall, with no public base URL required by @ikulikov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16251
* Made Rule Engine rebalancing faster and lighter by skipping inactive tenants by @smatvienko-tb in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16343
* Made Rule Engine startup faster with batched rule chain loading by @smatvienko-tb in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16344
* Added file attachments to AI Assistant and Solution Creator messages: images, PDFs, text and Office files by @ikulikov in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16551
* Added the details of each notification type to the REST API documentation by @vvlladd28 in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16557
* Added the platform version endpoint to the REST API documentation by @vvlladd28 in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16560
* Added CycloneDX SBOMs for ThingsBoard jars and installation packages by @dskarzh in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16567
* IoT Hub: added LoRaWAN device packages by @ShvaykaD in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16617
* Report templates: added border color, width and style settings for table columns, and a double line style for borders and dividers by @LeoMorgan113 in https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/pull/16287
* Fixed entity group owner and type being overwritten on update by @ViacheslavKlimov
* Made resending the sign-up activation email apply only to unverified users of the same self-registration domain by @ViacheslavKlimov
* Made getting or re-sending a us

![banner](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/526ba5f6-0944-4613-aac4-19a76158aa48)
# All-in-one IoT platform for data collection, processing, visualization, and device management.

💡 [Get started](https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/getting-started/) • 🌐 [Website](https://thingsboard.io/) • 📚 [Documentation](https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/) • 📔 [Blog](https://thingsboard.io/blog/) • 🔗 [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thingsboard/posts/?feedView=all)
## 🚀 Installation options Install ThingsBoard [on-premises](https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/installation/) or use [ThingsBoard Cloud](https://thingsboard.io/installations/). ## 💡 Getting started with ThingsBoard Check out our [Getting Started guide](https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/getting-started/) to learn the basics of ThingsBoard and create your first dashboard! You will learn to: * Connect devices to ThingsBoard * Push data from devices to ThingsBoard * Build real-time dashboards * Create a Customer and assign the dashboard with them. * Define thresholds and trigger alarms * Set up notifications via email, SMS, mobile apps, or integrate with third-party services. ## ✨ Features

Provision and manage
devices and assets

Provision, monitor and control your IoT entities in secure way using rich server-side APIs. Define relations between your devices, assets, customers or any other entities.


Read more ➜


Collect and visualize
your data

Collect and store telemetry data in scalable and fault-tolerant way. Visualize your data with built-in or custom widgets and flexible dashboards. Share dashboards with your customers.


Read more ➜


SCADA Dashboards

Monitor and control your industrial processes in real time with SCADA. Use SCADA symbols on dashboards to create and manage any workflow, offering full flexibility to design and oversee operations according to your requirements.


Read more ➜


Process and React

Turn raw telemetry into meaningful metrics with calculated fields: compute values, aggregates, and KPIs from device and asset data in real time. Combine them with rule chains to transform your data and raise alarms on telemetry events, attribute updates, device inactivity, and user actions.



Read more ➜

## ⚙️ Powerful IoT Rule Engine ThingsBoard allows you to create complex [Rule Chains](https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/user-guide/rule-engine/) to process data from your devices and match your application-specific use cases. [![IoT Rule Engine](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/43d21dc9-0e18-4f1b-8f9a-b72004e12f07 "IoT Rule Engine")](https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/user-guide/rule-engine/)
[**Read more about Rule Engine ➜**](https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/user-guide/rule-engine/)
## 📦 Real-Time IoT Dashboards ThingsBoard is a scalable, user-friendly, and device-agnostic IoT platform that speeds up time-to-market with powerful built-in solution templates. It enables data collection and analysis from any devices, saving resources on routine tasks and letting you focus on your solution’s unique aspects. See more of our use cases [here](https://thingsboard.io/iot-use-cases/). [**Smart energy**](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/smart-energy/) [![Smart energy](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2a0abf13-6dc5-4f5e-9c30-1aea1d39af1e "Smart energy")](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/smart-energy/) [**SCADA swimming pool**](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/scada/) [![SCADA Swimming pool](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/68fd9e29-99f1-4c16-8c4c-476f4ccb20c0 "SCADA Swimming pool")](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/scada/) [**Site fleet tracking**](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/site-fleet-tracking/) [![Site fleet tracking](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6ce0766-b138-4a42-86aa-7112a543026c "Site fleet tracking")](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/site-fleet-tracking/) [**Smart farming**](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/smart-farming/) [![Smart farming](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/56b84c99-ef24-44e5-a903-b925b7f9d142 "Smart farming")](https://thingsboard.io/use-cases/smart-farming/) [**Smart metering**](https://thingsboard.io/smart-metering/) [![Smart metering](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/adc05e3d-397c-48ef-bed6-535bbd698455 "Smart metering")](https://thingsboard.io/smart-metering/)
[**Check more of our use cases ➜**](https://thingsboard.io/iot-use-cases/)
